name: Temur War Shaman
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, manifest the top card of your library. (Put that card onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Whenever a permanent you control is turned face up, if it's a creature, you may have it fight target creature you don't control.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a permanent you control is turned face up, if it's a creature, you may have it fight target creature you don't control.

needs.what: a trigger event fired when a permanent is turned face up (morph, disguise, manifest, cloak), filterable by controller ('a permanent you control') and binding the turned-up permanent as the subject so the effect can read it (intervening-if 'if it's a creature', then an optional fight between it and a target creature you don't control)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no face-up event; the engine emits a 'turned_face_up' event from Game._turn_face_up but no trigger can listen to it. permanent_enters does not fire on turning face up, since the permanent never changes zones
